sml3000_page.badge_hospital: VALIDATED AT HOSPITAL MOINHOS DE VENTO
sml3000_page.title: SML-3000 — Patented Hospital Fall Prevention System
sml3000_page.subtitle: Real-time intelligent thermal monitoring protecting patients and preventing falls without compromising privacy with optical cameras.
sml3000_page.cta_whatsapp: Talk Directly with the Founder on WhatsApp
sml3000_page.section_problem_title: The Critical Problem in Hospital Beds
sml3000_page.problem_1_desc: Bed falls are one of the most frequent incidents during inpatient care, resulting in severe injuries and complications.
sml3000_page.problem_2_desc: Each fall incident generates $10k to $30k+ in extra surgeries, prolonged ICU care, and liability lawsuits.
sml3000_page.problem_3_desc: Standard optical cameras cannot be used in patient rooms due to severe privacy laws (GDPR/HIPAA/LGPD) and ethical concerns.
sml3000_page.section_solution_title: The Patented Solution: How SML-3000 Works
sml3000_page.solution_desc: The SML-3000 uses a high-sensitivity thermal sensor array combined with a dedicated microcontrolled PIC algorithm. The system continuously maps the bed temperature gradient and detects when a patient wakes up, shifts toward the edge, or attempts to stand, alerting the nursing station BEFORE the fall occurs.
sml3000_page.status_1: Definitive Patent of Invention Granted by INPI (BR 10 2015 013528-9).
sml3000_page.status_2: Clinical and operational real-world trials successfully concluded at Hospital Moinhos de Vento.
sml3000_page.status_3: Full acceptance by nursing staff, zero false ambient alarms, and total privacy compliance.
sml3000_page.status_4: Verified hospital customer demand waiting for final commercial product batch.
sml3000_page.needs_desc: All R&D uncertainty, circuit design, and clinical testing are complete. The requested capital is solely designated for Industrial Plastic Injection Tooling (Molds) and initial commercial production batch.
